module System where

data Nat : Set where
  Z : Nat
  S : Nat → Nat

plus : Nat → Nat → Nat
plus Z x = x
plus (S x) y = S (plus x y)

mult : Nat → Nat → Nat
mult Z x = Z
mult (S x) y = plus y (mult x y)

data leq : Nat → Nat → Set where
  leqZ : ∀ y → leq Z y
  leqS : ∀ {x y} → leq x y → leq (S x) (S y)

data _≡_ {A : Set} (x : A) : A → Set where
  refl : x ≡ x

subst : {A : Set} {P : A → Set} → (x y : A) → x ≡ y → P x → P y
subst _ _ refl px = px

sym : {A : Set} {x y : A} → x ≡ y → y ≡ x
sym refl = refl

record TokenID : Set where
  constructor mk_token_id
  field natVal : Nat

record VocabSize : Set where
  constructor mk_vocab_size
  field current : Nat
        max     : Nat

vocab_current : VocabSize → Nat
vocab_current (mk_vocab_size c _) = c

vocab_max : VocabSize → Nat
vocab_max (mk_vocab_size _ m) = m

vocab_invariant : VocabSize → Set
vocab_invariant (mk_vocab_size c m) = leq c m

record VocabAddition (v1 v2 : VocabSize) : Set where
  field
    addProof : v2 ≡ mk_vocab_size (S (vocab_current v1)) (vocab_max v1)
    invProof : vocab_invariant v2

vocab_add_preserves_invariant :
  (vs : VocabSize) →
  vocab_invariant vs →
  leq (S (vocab_current vs)) (vocab_max vs) →
  VocabAddition vs (mk_vocab_size (S (vocab_current vs)) (vocab_max vs))
vocab_add_preserves_invariant vs inv leqProof = record
  { addProof = refl
  ; invProof = leqProof
  }

data OptimizerMode : Set where
  Pretrain FinetuneLowMem Unlearn Retain : OptimizerMode

record Real : Set where
  constructor mk_real
  field val : Nat

record OptimizerState : Set where
  constructor mk_optimizer
  field lr   : Real
        mode : OptimizerMode
        step : Nat

optimizer_lr : OptimizerState → Real
optimizer_lr (mk_optimizer lr _ _) = lr

optimizer_mode : OptimizerState → OptimizerMode
optimizer_mode (mk_optimizer _ m _) = m

optimizer_step : OptimizerState → Nat
optimizer_step (mk_optimizer _ _ s) = s

record OptimizerModeSwitch (os : OptimizerState) (new_mode : OptimizerMode)
                           (ns : OptimizerState) : Set where
  field
    switchProof : ns ≡ mk_optimizer (optimizer_lr os) new_mode (S (optimizer_step os))

switch_mode_valid :
  (os : OptimizerState) →
  (new_mode : OptimizerMode) →
  OptimizerModeSwitch os new_mode
    (mk_optimizer (optimizer_lr os) new_mode (S (optimizer_step os)))
switch_mode_valid os new_mode = record { switchProof = refl }

record SparseMask : Set where
  constructor mk_sparse_mask
  field len   : Nat
        ratio : Real

mask_seq_len : SparseMask → Nat
mask_seq_len (mk_sparse_mask l _) = l

mask_sparsity : SparseMask → Real
mask_sparsity (mk_sparse_mask _ r) = r

sparse_mask_valid : SparseMask → Set
sparse_mask_valid (mk_sparse_mask l _) = leq (S Z) l

record QuantumCircuit : Set where
  constructor mk_quantum_circuit
  field num_qubits : Nat
        depth      : Nat

qc_num_qubits : QuantumCircuit → Nat
qc_num_qubits (mk_quantum_circuit n _) = n

qc_depth : QuantumCircuit → Nat
qc_depth (mk_quantum_circuit _ d) = d

quantum_circuit_valid : QuantumCircuit → Set
quantum_circuit_valid (mk_quantum_circuit n _) = leq (S Z) n

record MemoryAllocation : Set where
  constructor mk_memory
  field allocated : Nat
        maxMem    : Nat

mem_allocated : MemoryAllocation → Nat
mem_allocated (mk_memory a _) = a

mem_max : MemoryAllocation → Nat
mem_max (mk_memory _ m) = m

memory_invariant : MemoryAllocation → Set
memory_invariant (mk_memory a m) = leq a m

record MemoryAllocationStep (m1 : MemoryAllocation) (to_alloc : Nat)
                            (m2 : MemoryAllocation) : Set where
  field
    allocProof : m2 ≡ mk_memory (plus (mem_allocated m1) to_alloc) (mem_max m1)
    invProof : memory_invariant m2

allocate_memory_safe :
  (ma : MemoryAllocation) →
  (to_alloc : Nat) →
  memory_invariant ma →
  leq (plus (mem_allocated ma) to_alloc) (mem_max ma) →
  MemoryAllocationStep ma to_alloc
    (mk_memory (plus (mem_allocated ma) to_alloc) (mem_max ma))
allocate_memory_safe ma to_alloc inv leqProof = record
  { allocProof = refl
  ; invProof = leqProof
  }

record Perplexity : Set where
  constructor mk_perplexity
  field current   : Real
        threshold : Real

perp_current : Perplexity → Real
perp_current (mk_perplexity c _) = c

perp_threshold : Perplexity → Real
perp_threshold (mk_perplexity _ t) = t

data Bool : Set where
  True False : Bool

_<?_ : Nat → Nat → Bool
Z <? Z = False
Z <? (S y) = True
(S x) <? Z = False
(S x) <? (S y) = x <? y

if_then_else_ : Bool → {A : Set} → A → A → A
if True then t else f = t
if False then t else f = f

should_expand : Perplexity → VocabSize → Bool
should_expand p vs =
  if (Real.val (perp_current p)) <? (Real.val (perp_threshold p))
  then True
  else False

record SystemState : Set where
  constructor mk_system
  field vocab     : VocabSize
        optimizer : OptimizerState
        memory    : MemoryAllocation
        quantum   : QuantumCircuit

system_vocab : SystemState → VocabSize
system_vocab (mk_system v _ _ _) = v

system_optimizer : SystemState → OptimizerState
system_optimizer (mk_system _ o _ _) = o

system_memory : SystemState → MemoryAllocation
system_memory (mk_system _ _ m _) = m

system_quantum : SystemState → QuantumCircuit
system_quantum (mk_system _ _ _ q) = q

system_invariant : SystemState → Set
system_invariant ss = vocab_invariant (system_vocab ss)

data SystemTransition (s1 : SystemState) : SystemState → Set where
  AddVocabToken :
    let v1 = system_vocab s1
        v2 = mk_vocab_size (S (vocab_current v1)) (vocab_max v1)
        o1 = system_optimizer s1
        m1 = system_memory s1
        q1 = system_quantum s1
    in
    (leqProof : leq (S (vocab_current v1)) (vocab_max v1)) →
    SystemTransition s1 (mk_system v2 o1 m1 q1)

  SwitchOptMode :
    (newMode : OptimizerMode) →
    let v1 = system_vocab s1
        o1 = system_optimizer s1
        o2 = mk_optimizer (optimizer_lr o1) newMode (S (optimizer_step o1))
        m1 = system_memory s1
        q1 = system_quantum s1
    in
    SystemTransition s1 (mk_system v1 o2 m1 q1)

  AllocMem :
    (to_alloc : Nat) →
    let v1 = system_vocab s1
        o1 = system_optimizer s1
        m1 = system_memory s1
        m2 = mk_memory (plus (mem_allocated m1) to_alloc) (mem_max m1)
        q1 = system_quantum s1
    in
    (memInv : memory_invariant m1) →
    (leqProof : leq (plus (mem_allocated m1) to_alloc) (mem_max m1)) →
    SystemTransition s1 (mk_system v1 o1 m2 q1)

  NoOp : SystemTransition s1 s1

system_transition_preserves_invariant :
  (s1 s2 : SystemState) →
  system_invariant s1 →
  SystemTransition s1 s2 →
  system_invariant s2
system_transition_preserves_invariant s1 .s1 invS1 NoOp = invS1
system_transition_preserves_invariant s1 .(mk_system _ _ _ _) invS1 (AddVocabToken leqProof) = leqProof
system_transition_preserves_invariant s1 .(mk_system _ _ _ _) invS1 (SwitchOptMode newMode) = invS1
system_transition_preserves_invariant s1 .(mk_system _ _ _ _) invS1 (AllocMem to_alloc memInv leqProof) = invS1

entries.answer:
### Áttekintés

A kód *szintaktikailag* rendben van – a jelenlegi Agda (≥ 2.6.4) alatt lefordul. Néhány stiláris és szemantikai ponton azonban érdemes finomítani.

### Megfigyelt problémák

- **Felesleges paraméter**  
  should_expand kap egy VocabSize értéket, de nem használja. Ha valóban csak a perplexity‐re akar dönteni, akkor törölhető; ha a szótárméret is szerepet kell játsszon, illessze be a feltételbe.

- **Real csak Nat-ot tárol**  
  A Real rekord mezője Nat, így a név megtévesztő lehet. Ha valódi racionális/lebegőpontos értékekkel szeretnél dolgozni, alakítsd át (pl. párosíts num és den mezőkkel, vagy importálj egy megfelelő típust).

- **Figyelmeztetés „unused argument”**  
  A fordító a should_expand → vs, illetve több rekordmezőhöz tartozó lokális bizonyítás (inv, memInv) miatt figyelmeztethet, hogy a változó nem kerül felhasználásra. Ez ugyan nem hiba, de tisztábbá teszi a kódot, ha:

  - elhagyod a nem használt paramétert, vagy  
  - a definícióban _-gal jelzed, hogy szándékosan ignorálod.

- **Átláthatóság a let-kötésekben**  
  A SystemTransition konstruktorainál a hosszú let-blokk korrekt, de nehezebben olvasható. Egyszerűsíthetsz, ha külön segédfüggvényben állítod elő a cél SystemState-et, és csak arra hivatkozol.

### Javasolt apró módosítás

```agda
should_expand : Perplexity → Bool
should_expand p =
  if Real.val (perp_current p) <? Real.val (perp_threshold p)
  then True
  else False
```

Ha a VS-t is be akarod vonni:

```agda
should_expand : Perplexity → VocabSize → Bool
should_expand p vs =
  if Real.val (perp_current p) <? Real.val (perp_threshold p)
     ∧? (vocab_current vs <? vocab_max vs)
  then True
  else False
```

(∧? = saját Bool-os „és”.)

### Összegzés

Fordítási hibát nem találtam, csupán kisebb stiláris és tervezési kérdések merülnek fel. Ha más jellegű hibaüzenetet látsz, másold be, és segítek kibogozni.

record SystemState : Set where
  constructor mk_system
  field vocab     : VocabSize
        optimizer : OptimizerState
        memory    : MemoryAllocation
        quantum   : QuantumCircuit

system_vocab : SystemState → VocabSize
system_vocab (mk_system v _ _ _) = v

system_optimizer : SystemState → OptimizerState
system_optimizer (mk_system _ o _ _) = o

system_memory : SystemState → MemoryAllocation
system_memory (mk_system _ _ m _) = m

system_quantum : SystemState → QuantumCircuit
system_quantum (mk_system _ _ _ q) = q

system_invariant : SystemState → Set
system_invariant ss = vocab_invariant (system_vocab ss)

data SystemTransition (s1 : SystemState) : SystemState → Set where
  AddVocabToken :
    let v1 = system_vocab s1
        v2 = mk_vocab_size (S (vocab_current v1)) (vocab_max v1)
        o1 = system_optimizer s1
        m1 = system_memory s1
        q1 = system_quantum s1
    in
    (leqProof : leq (S (vocab_current v1)) (vocab_max v1)) →
    SystemTransition s1 (mk_system v2 o1 m1 q1)

  SwitchOptMode :
    (newMode : OptimizerMode) →
    let v1 = system_vocab s1
        o1 = system_optimizer s1
        o2 = mk_optimizer (optimizer_lr o1) newMode (S (optimizer_step o1))
        m1 = system_memory s1
        q1 = system_quantum s1
    in
    SystemTransition s1 (mk_system v1 o2 m1 q1)

  AllocMem :
    (to_alloc : Nat) →
    let v1 = system_vocab s1
        o1 = system_optimizer s1
        m1 = system_memory s1
        m2 = mk_memory (plus (mem_allocated m1) to_alloc) (mem_max m1)
        q1 = system_quantum s1
    in
    (memInv : memory_invariant m1) →
    (leqProof : leq (plus (mem_allocated m1) to_alloc) (mem_max m1)) →
    SystemTransition s1 (mk_system v1 o1 m2 q1)

  NoOp : SystemTransition s1 s1

  (s1 s2 : SystemState) →
